title: Anadolu reports storm injuries and collapses in Gaza
summary_or_snippet: Anadolu reported on November 7 that medical sources said five Palestinians were injured in separate storm-related incidents involving two wall collapses and falling corrugated metal in northern and central Gaza. Civil Defence spokesperson Mahmoud Basal separately described four collapses involving homes damaged by previous Israeli strikes, including partial and roof collapses, with no injuries reported in those four incidents. The report also described rain flooding displacement camps and shelters. These attributed accounts should not be combined into one casualty total.
traceability_note: By Ramzi Mahmud and Serdar Dincel. Article publication and update dates both November 7, 2026; no time or timezone shown. Source says storm began Friday evening, November 6; event_date November 7 refers to reported impacts, not onset. Older same-ID search headlines report two injured; use the fully read five-injury update without adding counts.
editorial_label: November 7 reported impacts; storm began November 6. Five injured people and four no-injury collapse responses remain separate.

title: ICSPR calls for shelter and emergency equipment after Gaza rains
summary_or_snippet: In a statement dated November 7, Palestinian rights organization ICSPR called for weather-resistant shelters, bedding, pumps, rescue equipment and fuel, and support for municipal and emergency services. It warned that poor drainage and sanitation could worsen disease risks. These are the organization's assessments and requests, not evidence that supplies had been delivered or a disease outbreak had occurred. The statement responds to the same storm described in the accompanying reporting.
traceability_note: Explicit statement date November 7, 2026; no publication clock or timezone shown. Underlying weather observations have no independent precise timestamp. Statement itself is the dated event. Numerical claims elsewhere draw on government, municipal, Civil Defence and UNRWA sources.
editorial_label: November 7 response statement about the same storm; assistance requested, not confirmed delivered.
